print.title: חכמת שמעון בן סירא
print.source_policy: Historical printed Hebrew in the project's public-domain source lane; the scan itself is not vendored.

note: POB scoped collation of the pinned Kahana-labelled digital base with Kahana's printed p.100 / PDF p.118. Restores a missing 19-star unit and an additional yod at 29; other digital wording and pointing are retained. This is not a diplomatic transcription of the whole print, an ancient manuscript, or an adjudicated earliest Hebrew text.
normalization: For the added 19-star unit only, the two printed columns are joined with a comma and the terminal printed punctuation is represented by a period. Other 19 wording and punctuation retain the pinned digital base. At 29 only the extra unpointed yod is restored; the remaining digital characters are unchanged. Printed and digital vowels are editorial, not ancient pointing.

observation.root: Complete printed p.100 and enlarged hand-verb, verse-29 and footnote details visually inspected.
observation.source_agent: Title pages and complete printed pp.99–101 / PDF pp.117–119 inspected.
observation.independent_reviewer: Complete printed p.100 and enlarged details checked in the preceding evidence review; not approval of this later application.

SIR.51.19.base_text: חַשְׁקָה נַפְשִׁי בָּהּ, וּפָנַי לֹא אַהֲפֹך מִמֶּנָּה.
SIR.51.19.text: חַשְׁקָה נַפְשִׁי בָּהּ, וּפָנַי לֹא אַהֲפֹך מִמֶּנָּה. יָדִי פָתְחָה שְׁעָרֶיהָ, וְלָהּ אֶחֱדַר וְאַבִּיט בָּהּ.
SIR.51.19.change: Append the missing printed 19-star content; retain digital 19's first unit, including its pointing. Grouping under 19 is a disclosed content mapping, not the physical printed order.
SIR.51.19.limits: The print attests this editorial reading; it does not decide the different B/11Q5/Greek readings, poetic tense or earliest poem.

SIR.51.29.base_text: תִּשְׂמַח נַפְשִׁי בְּשֵׂיבָתִי, וְלֹא תֵבוֹשוּ בְּשִׁירָתִי.
SIR.51.29.text: תִּשְׂמַח נַפְשִׁי בְּישֵׂיבָתִי, וְלֹא תֵבוֹשוּ בְּשִׁירָתִי.
SIR.51.29.change: Restore the extra unpointed yod after beth. Retain the editorial sin/tsere reading and the rest of the pinned digital text.
SIR.51.29.print_footnote_fact: Kahana explains the intended sense as rejoicing in old age and identifies the song with this book, written as verse.
SIR.51.29.limits: The spelling alone does not compel an English teaching/session rendering; unpointed B and Kahana's editorial interpretation remain distinct.
